log.verdict: checker rejected: The headline states 'the Architectural Review Board reviews a proposal' but the official item identifies this as a 'QUASI-JUDICIAL' matter before the body listed as 'Architectural Review Board.' This creates ambiguity about whether the ARB is the decision-making body or a reviewing body in a quasi-judicial process. The headline's phrasing could mislead readers about the actual nature and scope of the proceeding. To be grounded, the headline should either clarify the quasi-judicial nature or specify the exact body/process with precision matching the official item.
